#include "postgres.h"

#include <sys/types.h>	/* for off_t */

/* Simple macro with a continuation line. */
#define SAMPLE_MAX(a, b) \
	((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))	/* evaluates twice */

/*
 * sample_insert
 *		Insert a tuple into the heap relation.
 *
 * The caller must hold at least RowExclusiveLock on the relation.
 * See heap_insert() for the real thing; XLogRecPtr is returned.
 */
static int
sample_insert(int relation, const char *tuple)
{
	int			result = 0;		/* return value */
	const char *marker = "/* not a comment */ // nor this";
	char		quote = '"';
	char		slash = '/';

	if (tuple == NULL)
		return -1;				// nothing to do

	switch (relation)
	{
		case 1:
			result = 1;
			/* FALLTHROUGH */
		case 2:
			result += 2;
			break;
		default:
			/* translator: %s is a relation name */
			elog(ERROR, "unexpected relation %d", relation);
	}

	(void) quote;
	(void) slash;
	(void) marker;
	return result;
}

/*
 * A comment mentioning pg_attribute_noreturn() must stay as is.
 */
static void
sample_noop(void)
{
	/* nothing */
}
